ValidationRule.errorConditionFormula: AND( RecordType.DeveloperName = 'Privileged_Opportunity', OR( ISPICKVAL( StageName , 'Closed Won'), ISPICKVAL( StageName , 'Closed Lost') ), ISPICKVAL( PRIORVALUE(StageName) , 'Ready to Close'), NOT(oppy_modification_name__c) )
ValidationRule.errorMessage: Please note that this Opportunity has Inside Information and it must be closed from the appropriate button at the top of the page. A request will be sent to Compliance in order to change Information disclosure field to Confidential when possible.
